mission.p1: Frallicciardi specializes in the fabrication and transformation of plexiglass and related materials, designing and manufacturing bespoke products for the luxury marine sector.
mission.p2: For over 28 years, we have combined traditional maritime craftsmanship with innovative systems and materials. Catering to premium shipyards and discerning private clients, our focus remains on meticulous attention to every single detail.
mission.p3: Our primary objective is client satisfaction, fostering clear and seamless collaborations from the very beginning. Our hallmarks in the maritime sector are reliability, transparency, and absolute efficiency.
